semantic_cases.rule: Keep detailed operation kind as a mandatory, typed effective-operation discriminator separate from broad action_kind transport categories (FILESYSTEM, TERMINAL, etc.) and separate from action_class. A category alone never authorizes an effect.
semantic_cases.mapping: Legacy kind=file_write -> action_kind=FILESYSTEM AND operation=file_write; kind=file_delete -> FILESYSTEM AND operation=file_delete; kind=shell -> TERMINAL AND operation=shell, subject to authorized tool scope.
semantic_cases.reject: If the exact effect operation, target, reversibility, preconditions, or authorization scope is missing, no SHARED_WORLD dispatch and no automated canonical migration.
semantic_cases.witness: Two proposals with identical action_kind=FILESYSTEM but different delete/write semantics must remain distinguishable at ActionGate and sealed executor; include symlink-target switch.
semantic_cases.proof: Signed/effective operation specs with explicit discriminator; version/integrity-resolvable context; downstream use and reverse-projection proof.

semantic_cases.source_declarations: FCA v1.0.1:FCA v1.0.1 baseline:387,RDMS-02:Original draft:132,RDMS-02:Original draft:211
semantic_cases.rule: RDMS-02 C01 support assessment governs current support; FCA evidence_for/evidence_against and provenance must remain recoverable via accepted RDMS-03 EvidenceLink relations and historical provenance. FactGrounding remains mandatory for FACT.
semantic_cases.mapping: Claim identity/kind/statement/scope/status/version -> RDMS-02 canonical record; support -> separately governed SupportAssessment; evidence arrays -> link relation queries constrained to claim and accepted status; provenance -> lineage refs.
semantic_cases.reject: Missing source provenance or grounding cannot be promoted into FACT/VERIFIED; a claim with untraceable contradictory evidence enters review, not verified status.
semantic_cases.witness: FACT, BELIEF, ASSUMPTION with positive and negative evidence; challenge a previously strong claim using late contradictory observation; no silent drop.
semantic_cases.proof: Source version lineage, evidence links, grounding, support-assessment provenance and temporal validity reconstruct FCA-level meaning.

semantic_cases.source_declarations: FCA v1.0.1:FCA v1.0.1 baseline:662,RDMS-03:Original draft:632,RDMS-03:C01 and Freeze Review 02 Final:2381
semantic_cases.rule: Use RDMS-03 lifecycle as current owner. FCA UNRESOLVED is an active unresolved epistemic condition, never map to RDMS-03 RESOLVED. For legacy migration preserve historical UNRESOLVED claim and derive unresolved as nonterminal/non-dismissed with no accepted resolution, only when demonstrably equivalent.
semantic_cases.mapping: candidate -> CANDIDATE; confirmed -> CONFIRMED; explained -> EXPLAINED only with admissible explanation; unresolved -> unresolved condition/history, not RDMS lifecycle RESOLVED. RDMS RESOLVED needs its own closing proof.
semantic_cases.reject: Without a valid lifecycle history, comparable observation sources and explanation/resolution evidence, do not auto-convert legacy unresolved to any terminal value.
semantic_cases.witness: Same observations but different times are NOT_COMPARABLE; later contradictory observation reopens question; UNRESOLVED must never disappear through RESOLVED alias.
semantic_cases.proof: State history with comparability assessment, observation references, interpretation/proof separation and unresolved-state query.

semantic_cases.source_declarations: FCA v1.0.1:FCA v1.0.1 baseline:616,RDMS-03:Original draft:461,RDMS-03:Original draft:514
semantic_cases.rule: RDMS-03 may bind multiple canonical observation_refs to one EvidenceLink with individual provenance; a FCA single observation_id view can be emitted only when cardinality equals one or via explicit composite link reference preserving whole set, not by silently spawning several independent accepted links.
semantic_cases.mapping: FCA observation_id -> singleton observation_refs; RDMS multiple observation_refs -> collection-level evidence with full lineage. Target relation, derivation and acceptance remain distinct.
semantic_cases.reject: Zero observations cannot form accepted EvidenceLink; untrusted generated text, duplicated observation or missing source cannot gain accepted evidential authority through projection.
semantic_cases.witness: Two observations and one interpretation accepted as one link, vs two independent links; assert different evidence cardinality and identical canonical provenance on reconstruction.
semantic_cases.proof: Observation ID multiplicity, link IDs, acceptance history, signed source trace and exact target/relation preservation.

semantic_cases.rule: RDMS-03 Experiment is the authorized immutable design; ExperimentRun owns execution and outcome. FCA aggregate Experiment is a compatibility view over the design plus zero/multiple runs; design lifecycle does not inherit RUNNING or FAILED.
semantic_cases.mapping: FCA designed/authorized -> design-state translation; running/completed/failed/cancelled -> explicit run(s) and observation/conclusion provenance, never design-state substitution.
semantic_cases.reject: Legacy aggregate with RUNNING but no identifiable run, pre-committed prediction set or action authorization must be reviewed; do not infer design or retroactively freeze predictions.
semantic_cases.witness: One design -> two runs: first failed, second completed; same predictions predate both, and conclusion links back to correct runs.
semantic_cases.proof: ExperimentID/RunID mapping, immutable prediction hashes, risk/authorization, run timestamps, observations and status history.

semantic_cases.source_declarations: FCA v1.0.1:FCA v1.0.1 baseline:472,RDMS-02:Original draft:382,RDMS-02:C01, second review corrections and final freeze decision:2117
semantic_cases.rule: RDMS-02 C01 separates support assessment from lifecycle. Strongly supported or CONFIRMED hypotheses are not CAUSALLY_VERIFIED merely by ranking; only correctly evidenced causal-closure path to OVC can justify verified causal status.
semantic_cases.mapping: FCA predictions, positive/negative evidence, competitors and experiments -> typed references and RDMS-03 accepted links; support and hypothesis lifecycle kept separate; historical support source retained.
semantic_cases.reject: Cannot upgrade to CAUSALLY_VERIFIED if persisted prediction, intervention, regression or scope proof missing; no independent synthetic causal owner.
semantic_cases.witness: High support but no intervention; refuted competitor; confirmed but not operationally verified; intervention-based causal closure.
semantic_cases.proof: Typed reference resolution for each FCA cognitive relation and explicit authorized OVC verification record.

semantic_cases.rule: RDMS-03 stores normalized observation with immutable raw artifact provenance and source/capture/ingest time separation. The original reported content remains retrievable; a trusted envelope or checksum proves integrity/provenance, not truth of source claim.
semantic_cases.mapping: FCA observation content/observed_at/source -> RDMS-03 raw_artifact_ref, normalized report and TemporalProvenance (event/capture/ingest clocks) with original source identity.
semantic_cases.reject: Missing raw bytes, degraded source trust or unknown event timestamp cannot be silently repaired by ingestion timestamp or promoted to verified fact.
semantic_cases.witness: Late-arriving log with event_time < ingestion_time; duplicated message; spoofed tool success that must remain report, not verified world effect.
semantic_cases.proof: Raw byte hash, explicit source identity, clock trust, event order, capture integrity and interpretation provenance.

semantic_cases.rule: RDMS-02 C01 verification_ref resolves complete FCA causal-closure checklist and its temporal order; canonical causal history and derived dependency freshness are distinct. Staleness is not evidence of causal refutation and later validity does not rewrite historical causal closure.
semantic_cases.mapping: FCA verification {reproduction, prior prediction, targeted intervention, expected effect, regression, weakened alternatives, optional ablation} -> versioned verification_ref and evidence/observation references; FCA operational status with RDMS canonical lifecycle + derived freshness view.
semantic_cases.reject: Any missing mandatory proof element, broken pre-intervention time ordering, unresolved contradiction or invalid scope blocks OPERATIONALLY_VERIFIED.
semantic_cases.witness: Proof missing prediction persistence; ablation present; dependency becomes stale and returns VALID; distinguish lifecycle history from current applicability.
semantic_cases.proof: Ref dereference yields full source checklist with chronological commits, authority, specific environment and dependency frontier.

phase6_high_priority.rule: FCA full semantic result remains canonical. L7 CapabilityTransportResult must resolve immutable original and preserve all fields, including needs, rationale and specialist_request.
RDMS-07 retrieval coverage/ranking/filtering remains canonical. L7 MemoryRetrievalTransportResult is a bounded view with required canonical reference.
No direct field union; purpose, owner, scope, links, statement, follow-up, timestamp and sequence remain distinct; RDMS-02 C01 reactivation root mandatory.
FCA full trigger vs RDMS-05 predicate; use distinct effective names and reconstruct full trigger with both detection and fire axes and exact reaction identity.
FCA complete recovery-context fields must remain in verified durable RDMS-05 C01 payload with integrity-pinned header, and resume never auto-dispatches next action.
